near_k.description: How many neighbours one `near` asks the source for; each becomes an `inferred` edge with its `score` (1 to 20).

nodes_cap.description: The most nodes one `outline` asks for; a source announcing more is indexed up to it.

links_cap.description: The most edges one `links` asks for.

scan_max.description: The most rows one read of phase 2 takes (the sources of the space, the edges into a source).

description.purpose: Keeps the graph of the space current: an announcement (`source_changed`) is recorded with the round of its source (`audience_set`) and pulled -- `outline`, `links` and, for a file space, `near`; each `pull` names its source in `hop.source` -- the answers are parked until the set is complete, a stale version is dropped, and the rest is written in two store bundles: phase 1 replaces the source's nodes, names and edges and reads back (resolved edges on a name the source provides included, so the store does not depend on the order sources arrive), phase 2 resolves edges by compare-and-set -- direct addresses (`fh-`/`ob-`, with or without an anchor) by the node they name. A `tomb` drops the source, breaks every extracted edge into it, deletes the inferred ones and decides again the edges its removal may have made unique.
description.use_when: Inside a graph space only, behind `source_changed` and `in_pulled`.
description.not_in_scope: No question (`./query`), no model, no network, no content of a source.
description.emits_meaning: `index_store` to `./store` between phases, `pull` out of the hive (three per announcement of a file space, two of an object hive), `hop.source` set.
description.consumes_meaning: An announcement (with the source's `audience_set`, if it has one), a source's answer to a pull, and the store's answers to its own bundles.
